name: Beata Szydło - Après le § 2 - Am 3
title: REPORT on the security of energy supply in the EU
part_text: 2a. Expresses concern about the overly excessive focus of EU policies on electrification and renewables; states the need to promote a diversified energy mix, including clean and low-carbon energies, in order to ensure security of energy supply and competitiveness; strongly stresses the need for actions aimed at reducing volatility and lowering high energy prices, which are having a heavy impact on businesses and consumers; warns, in any event, against any Commission initiatives that could circumvent Treaty provisions assigning competence over the energy mix to Member States;
